gridDNA: A solid vibrant blue background with a dominant left-aligned text block in the top-left quadrant, a hero product shot angled in the mid-right, a prominent call-to-action button below the main text, and a distinct footer band containing secondary brand information and a disclaimer.

typeScale: headline ~10-12% of canvas height, sub ~3-4%, body ~4%, caption ~1%
colourBlocking: Full-bleed solid vibrant blue for the top ~80% of the canvas, with an implied white/light footer band at the bottom ~20% where dark text is placed. The CTA button is a distinct terracotta colour.
negativeSpace: Ample negative space in the top-right and bottom-left (above footer) allows the headline and product to breathe and stand out, creating a clean, uncluttered feel. The blue background itself is a large negative space.
whyItWins: The clear visual hierarchy, strong contrast, and strategic placement of the offer, product, and call-to-action create an immediate understanding of value and a direct path to conversion.
